author: Brandjuh
name: CuffEmbed
short: Posts other cogs' plain-text messages as embeds (payday, freecredits, drops).
description: The stock and third-party cogs answer in plain text where every cuff-cog answers in an embed. This cog wraps the two send paths every cog goes through and re-renders their messages as embeds — with a title and colour for the ones it recognises (a payday payout, a cooldown, a refusal) and a plain precinct-gold box for the rest. Only allow-listed cogs are touched (economy, payday, cashdrop, extendedeconomy, heist, city, simplecasino by default; widen with [p]cuffembed add). No upstream file is edited, so a cog update cannot undo it.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data. It only rewrites the appearance of messages the bot sends.
